finding.before: The elementary probability family assumed six faces and probability1/6 for every requested X=k, even for an explicitly eight-faced die or an event outside its support.
finding.after: A closed statement grammar requires an explicit uniform support of consecutive integer labels, its coherent cardinality, X as the result, and a singleton event. Membership is checked:1/N inside the support,0 outside. Missing/different variable definitions, conditioning or inconsistent support cause explicit abstention.

scientific_argument: A uniform variable on N distinct integer labels assigns1/N to each supported value and0 to any other singleton. The complete consecutive support has cardinality last-first+1; no face count or random-variable definition is inferred from the word die.
relationship_to_previous_qa: QA011 concerned expected value only. Its closure did not cover this separate probability family.
review_limits: The grammar deliberately refuses a statement that never binds X to the result, even if a human would infer that convention.
No actual question is removed or modified.
This is a bounded proof of one solver family, not complete QCM scientific or human review.
Le lecteur commun option_value interprète encore à tort certaines unités et pourcentages : cette famille entière ne peut pas être déclarée scientifiquement fermée avant sa correction.
